register_qwen_models: register all Qwen model families including Qwen2.5, Qwen2.5 VL, QwQ, and QVQ Preview
register_qwen_2_5_models: register Qwen2.5 language models with 3B and 7B sizes and supported quantization types
register_qwen_2_5_vl_models: register Qwen2.5 vision-language models with 3B, 7B, 32B, and 72B sizes
register_qwen_qwq_models: register QwQ reasoning models and QVQ Preview vision models from the Qwen organization
run_main_validation: run the module as a script to validate all registered Qwen model entries in the model registry
